# MDL107 · `empty-key`

<!-- Generated by tools/gendocs from internal/rules: do not edit. -->

A line starts with `=`: the key is empty.

| | |
|---|---|
| Family | loading |
| Default severity | error |
| Fix | — |
| Flags | unsuppressible |
| Design references | K7, case 23 |

## Why

GLib treats a line as a key/value pair only if there is a key before the `=`. A line such as `=1` is rejected, and mydumper ignores the whole file.

## Example

❌ Before:

```ini
[mydumper]
=1
```

```text
2:1-2:3 error MDL107[empty-key] line starts with `=`: there is no key before it (GLib: Key file contains line “=1” which is not a key-value pair, group, or comment)
  = mydumper ignores this entire file: it only logs a WARNING ("Failed to load config file") and runs with its defaults, exit code 0.
```

## Configuration

Enabled by default. To change its severity or turn it off:

```yaml
rules:
  severity:
    MDL107: warning   # or error, info, off
```

Its diagnostics mean mydumper ignores the whole file: they cannot be suppressed by comments, only by the configuration or `--ignore`.
